summary: Large gravel club car park, no homes nearby, east end near croquet lawns.
reasons: Surrounded by sports clubs and parkland

best_section.where: East end of the gravel car park, by the path past the war memorial

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto croquet and bowls greens and parkland; only sports buildings nearby, no homes mapped or visible.
drivers.access_and_room: Open gravel car park off the road at the west end; plenty of room to pull out of traffic.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side road; car park busy by day with club cars.
drivers.convention: Club car park with many cars by day; clubs are non-residential. Overnight use unknown.

flags: Busy with club cars in the daytime, may be used for evening events
Mapped locked gates 57 m and 151 m away have a way round
sun_shade: Open gravel, little cover; a few palms to the south-east give partial shade.
cannot_judge: Whether the car park is closed or signed at night
